chunks.name: engine_bridge
chunks.doc: 🌉️ Engine bridge: the typed translation of the transient scene into the precompute `SceneConfig` and the sync and drive calls that feed one precompute session.

chunks.name: action_context
chunks.doc: 🎬️ Action context: everything one command arm may read or write while the dispatch prologue and epilogue stay in the dispatcher.

chunks.name: context_menu
chunks.doc: 🖱️ Context menu: the localized row builder, the surface selection and the object, vortex, volume and reference menu items.

chunks.name: session_registry
chunks.doc: 🗃️ Session registry: the process-wide slots that keep one document instance's session across calls, the instance operation owner and the session itself.

chunks.name: instance_residency
chunks.doc: 🏘️ Instance residency: the per-object instance record text, its fingerprints and delta, the scene geometry fingerprint and the world mesh lane.
